evidence: deck-trans: baseline, u8-casts, int8-casts, int8-casts+compound-add, u8-casts+compound-add all compile 576 bytes under both flag sets (extent-blocked vs 582), identical aggregate known_differing_bytes 833.

Instruction diff of the /O2 baseline vs image: image prologue is sub esp/push esi/mov [esp+slot],0/mov eax,[esi+0x5a4]; test eax,eax with push ebx+ebp emitted only after the row-count jle (0x0062AF81 region), remaining reloaded as mov eax,[esp+slot]; test eax,eax at each packet-loop head, epilogue pops ebp/ebx before edi; compiled instead pushes ebx in the prologue, keeps remaining in ebx, and spills via cmp-with-ebx.
payload.hypothesis: decode_byte_run_trans's remaining /O2 gap (576 vs extent 582, all five row-loop cast spellings plateau) is register allocation, not spelling: the image zero-initializes scratch with an immediate store (mov [esp+slot],0), sinks push ebx/push ebp under the row-loop guard, tests members via mov+test rather than cmp-with-zeroed-ebx, and keeps remaining memory-homed with volatile-register tests; none of these are reachable from idiomatic packet-loop spellings.
